engine_bay.title: Engine bay photo
engine_bay.hint: Point the tablet at the engine compartment. Capture overall context — leaks, missing covers, obvious damage.

door_jamb.title: Door jamb VIN
door_jamb.hint: Photograph the VIN sticker on the driver door jamb. Hold steady for OCR.
door_jamb.skip_warning: Skipping VIN means prior visit history won't preload. You can enter VIN manually later.

dashboard.title: Ignition ON — dashboard
instructions: Turn the key to ON (accessory) — do not start the engine.
Wait for warning lamps to illuminate and the odometer to display.
Capture the instrument cluster: warning lights and mileage.
dashboard.skip_note: Optional — helps triage electrical and no-start concerns.
